AUTHOR: Ahn
TITLE: Flounders Measurement System using Obtained Optical Images by AUV
REGION: Japan (AUV seafloor images provided by National Maritime Research Institute; site not stated)
SPECIES: Flounders (Pleuronectidae) target; classifier classes: flounder, ray, starfish, crab, fishing net, sea cucumber, seaweed, seafloor, other fish
DATA: AUV seafloor still images; 3,406 training images; 10 randomly selected evaluation images
V_EV: [V1 recoded NR on verification: statement not about the study's own water clarity] Sec. II-A/Fig. 2: 'low visibility images which are affected by light attenuation and reflectance of seafloor'; 'Photographed alititude: 2.75m, Average value of image color intensity'
D2: 3,406 training images; 10 randomly selected evaluation images (disjointness not stated)
D_EV: Sec. III: 'For the evaluation randomly 10 images are selected' - no grouping or relation to training images stated.
R_EV: Sec. III: evaluation on 10 AUV seafloor images from the same AUV image source as training ('randomly 10 images are selected')
E_EV: Sec. III-C: 'the estimated flounders length [pixel] are compared with the human counted flounders length [pixel]'; 'The average of error is 6 [pixel]'
ARCH: Retinex enhancement + Sobel/morphology candidate region selection + AlexNet classifier + rotation-based length measurement
METR: Region selection error rate, recognition accuracy (vs human counts per image), length error (pixels)
NOTE: Very small evaluation (10 images, ~23 flounders). Counts per image and pixel lengths compared with human reading of the same images (E1 coded 복수: counts + length). Length only in pixels for evaluation; conversion to cm shown for one example. Camera altitude (2.5-3.05 m) reported per image (V4); mean RGB intensity reported (V5 기타). Depth not given. Evaluation images' independence from training set unknown -> D NR.
